_comment: ARCNAVE modernization P5 (O5) dependency policy allowlist — read by scripts/audit-policy-gate.js. Only HIGH/CRITICAL advisories need an entry here; MODERATE/LOW stay informational (npm audit still reports them, see dependency-scan-baseline.md). Every entry needs a real 'reason' and 'recorded' date — this is an accepted-risk log, not a blanket suppression.

accepted.reason: Command injection in glob's own CLI (-c/--cmd), transitive dev-only dependency of node-pg-migrate (migration tooling). Never invoked as a CLI, never in the request path. Fix needs a node-pg-migrate major bump not yet scheduled.

ICNS parser infinite-loop DoS, transitive via pptxgenjs (PPT export). This codebase never embeds images through pptxgenjs's image path, so the vulnerable parser is never exercised. Fix needs pptxgenjs@1.1.5, a major downgrade from the pinned ^4.0.1 with its own breaking-API regression risk — tracked, not yet scheduled.
Same package/exposure as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr above (JXL/HEIF parsers instead of ICNS) — same reasoning, same fix, same unscheduled-major-downgrade blocker.
